# Vendored third-party sources. Fetched by `make vendor` (see dreamosc/Makefile).
#
# Format: <repo-url> <sha> <path-in-repo> <dest-path-relative-to-repo-root>
#
# Rules:
#   - Pin an exact SHA, never a branch. Reproducible + auditable.
#   - Never edit vendored files in place. If upstream is broken, bump the SHA to
#     a fixed upstream commit, or work around it from our own code.
#   - Upstream chosen as the SOURCE OF TRUTH, not the most convenient copy:
#     pichenettes/stmlib is the canonical home of shy_fft.h (Mutable
#     Instruments, 2012-2023). Electro-Smith's DaisyExamples carries a copy but
#     pins stmlib at 5dc8b89 (June 2021), which predates the Math<double>
#     cos/sin infinite-recursion fix (PR #7, merged 2021-11-13) -- pinning there
#     would institutionalize a known-buggy snapshot.
#
# d18def8 is current stmlib master (2023-09-03). For fft/shy_fft.h it is
# byte-identical to the fix commit 83550a9, verified by diff.

https://github.com/pichenettes/stmlib d18def816c51d1da0c108236928b2bbd25c17481 fft/shy_fft.h dreamosc/vendor_stmlib/shy_fft.h
https://github.com/pichenettes/stmlib d18def816c51d1da0c108236928b2bbd25c17481 stmlib.h dreamosc/vendor_stmlib/stmlib/stmlib.h
